manifest_row.title: Naomi Klein Getting Caught Up In The Climate Wars

screening.main_topic: A critique of Naomi Klein’s arguments about climate change, fossil fuels, energy policy, and the relationship between environmental destruction and oppression.
screening.climate_relevance: Climate change politics and responses are central to the article, including discussion of fossil fuels, nuclear power, emissions from agriculture, and reducing climate destabilisation.
screening.reason: Although the article also discusses Indigenous dispossession, health, and cancer, these topics are repeatedly connected to its sustained evaluation of climate arguments and energy choices. Its sceptical or contrarian positions remain relevant climate discourse.
